arms.baseline: Exact frozen tuned_round2; no fertilizer logistics or timely harvest
arms.fertilizer: Exact terminal_v2 except remove fertilized yield>=2 early-maturity override
arms.harvest: Exact tuned_round2 plus the original fertilized yield>=2 early-maturity override; expected inactive without fertilizer, intentional negative control

budget: One design, no tuning/development selection; all six new seed clusters retained
primary_metric: Own final net profit, paired same seed/opponent/seat; seed is resampling unit

bootstrap.scope: Bonferroni nominal family 95%; six clusters only, exploratory bootstrap, exact sign tests also reported

acceptance: All 144+4 games complete official 720 states/719 actions, no errors, every replay reexecuted and matched; repeats match banks and ordered semantic hashes; all frozen sources/history preserved. Mechanism successful use and negative control reported. No profit gate required to finish an ablation, no automatic teacher/default promotion.
interpretation: Contributions conditional on this fixed controller and opponents; shared market and opponent response are part of total effect. Harvest-only inactivity is not evidence all unfertilized harvest strategies are useless. No per-action marginal profit claims.
failure_policy: Do not retune after results, change seeds, exclude valid matches or silently replace failures. Report negative/inconclusive results.
